versions.content: Frame preemption status classification of ex- press Ethernet frames on egress per traffic class Status: DRAFT If EthSwtFramePreemptionEnable is set to TRUE for an EthSwtPort, then all Ethernet frames in the EthSwtPortQueues of the corresponding EthSwt- PortEgress are classified as express Ethernet frames, where the EthSwtTraffic- ClassToPreemptionStatusAssignment is set to ETHSWT_TRAFFIC_CLASS_- EXPRESS.

Frame preemption status classification of ex- press Ethernet frames on egress per traffic class Status: DRAFT If EthSwtFramePreemptionEnable is set to TRUE for an EthSwtPort , then all Ethernet frames in the EthSwtPortQueue s of the corresponding EthSwt- PortEgress are classified as express Ethernet frames, where the EthSwtTraffic- ClassToPreemptionStatusAssignment is set to ETHSWT_TRAFFIC_CLASS_- EXPRESS .
